title: Release Engineering Weekly — 2026-03-03
content:
Release Engineering Weekly Meeting — 2026-03-03
Owner: Ava Chen (release manager)
Attendees: Miguel Ramirez, Priya Kumar, Liam O'Connor, Sofia Martinez, Tom Nguyen (on call), Heather Li (SRE)
Absent: N/A

Agenda:
- Release train status (v2.1, v2.2)
- Hotfix cadence and recent hotfix summary
- Change log highlights for next deploy window
- Blockers, risks, and rollback readiness
- Action items / owners

1) Release train status
- v2.1 (current stable train)
  - Target: GA on 2026-03-10. Currently in final validation and perf testing.
  - Components: serving-runtime 2.1.4, routing-service 1.8.0, console 3.0.0-beta.
  - Testing: integration smoke passed on staging (basic flows), second round of load tests scheduled 2026-03-04 (Miguel).
  - Known issues: small memory leak in kv-cache when handling long chats (tracked in JIRA:RI-1234). Mitigation: deploy kv-cache limit flags in canary.

- v2.2 (next train)
  - Timeline: feature freeze 2026-03-17, rollout window 2026-03-24+
  - Major changes: continuous-batching improvements, new quantization profile for A100, routing policy tweaks for dedicated customers.
  - Dependencies: need serving-runtime PR #998 merged and validated (PR link in linked artifacts).

2) Recent hotfixes
- Hotfix H-2026-03-01 applied to production (2026-03-01 03:15 UTC)
  - Cause: regression causing 5–10% increased tail latency under specific burst patterns (root cause: incorrect backoff in routing-service).
  - Fix: revert problematic backoff change and add additional guard (PR: gh-1122).
  - Impact: rolled forward with zero customer-facing incidents; SLOs recovered within 10 minutes post-deploy.
  - Postmortem: short write-up started (linked artifact JIRA:RI-1250).

- Hotfix H-2026-03-02 (staging only)
  - Purpose: test new quantization flags before canary in v2.1. Minor perf variance observed; further tuning needed (Priya to continue).

3) Change log highlights for next deploy
- Serving-runtime: 2.1.4
  - Fix: kv-cache leak mitigation (flag gated).
  - Perf: improved memory footprint for short-sequence workloads.
  - Breaking: none.

- Routing-service: 1.8.0
  - Fix: backoff regression revert.
  - Feature: per-customer routing policy TTLs.

- Console: 3.0.0-beta
  - Feature: rollouts UI updates (canary weight visualizations).
  - Note: UI feature behind feature flag; ops-only in first rollout.

4) Blockers / Risks
- KV-cache memory leak (RI-1234) — risk to canary if flag not applied. Mitigation: enable flag on canary nodes only and monitor memory delta for 48h (Owner: Miguel).
- PR #998 outstanding integration tests failing intermittently — blocks v2.2 timeline if not stabilized. Owner: Priya.
- Capacity: Dedicated pool for EU customers has limited buffer for v2.1 canary; coordinating with infra to reserve burst capacity for 2026-03-05 canary (Owner: Liam).
- On-call bandwidth next week reduced due to travel (Tom OOO 2026-03-05–2026-03-09). Need extra standby (Sofia to cover pager during Tom's travel).

5) Rollback / Recovery readiness
- Standard rollback playbook validated last week. Canary rollback time measured at ~7 minutes (avg) for serving-runtime.
- Rollback checklist: disable traffic, revert canary config, monitor consumer queues and SLOs for 30m.
- Warm standby: if canary shows >2% customer error increase, auto-fallback to previous model variant is configured (confirm owners: SRE + Release).

6) Action items (explicit)
- Miguel Ramirez: Run extended memory delta load test for kv-cache flag on 2026-03-04; report by EOD 2026-03-04. (status: in_progress)
- Priya Kumar: Stabilize PR #998 integration tests; create follow-up plan if flakes persist. Due 2026-03-06. (status: in_progress)
- Liam O'Connor: Coordinate reserved burst capacity with infra for EU dedicated pool; confirm by 2026-03-05. (status: todo)
- Sofia Martinez: Cover pager for Tom during 2026-03-05–09 travel window; update on-call rotation doc. Due 2026-03-04. (status: todo)
- Ava Chen: Prepare canary rollout plan for v2.1 (include metrics dashboard and rollback gates) and share with SRE by 2026-03-05. (status: in_progress)
- Heather Li (SRE): Add extra tracing for routing-service backoff path; validate trace sampling on canary. Due 2026-03-04. (status: todo)

7) Notes / Decisions
- Agreed: apply kv-cache leak flag only to canary nodes for v2.1; do not enable cluster-wide until memory trend is stable for 48h.
- Agreed: if PR #998 cannot be stabilized by 2026-03-06, postpone v2.2 feature freeze and rebaseline timeline.
- Agreed: maintain hotfix cadence (max 48h turnaround for P0/P1 regressions) and ensure postmortem within 3 business days.

8) Quick standup log (since last meeting)
- Miguel: completed first round of load tests; observed memory delta +8% in long chat scenario.
- Priya: rerunning flaky integration tests; suspect CI resource contention on certain runners.
- Liam: spoke with infra — potential for temporary reserved capacity; pending confirmation.
- Sofia: updated on-call schedule draft.

9) Next meeting
- Date/time: Weekly sync — 2026-03-10 09:30 UTC (same channel)
- Pre-reads: canary rollout plan (Ava), updated load test results (Miguel), PR stabilization notes (Priya).

10) Misc / parking lot
- Discuss postmortem template for hotfixes — who owns the trace + cost correlation? (parking)
- Evaluate automation for canary memory gating (follow-up).

Document owner: Ava Chen
Notes recorded: 2026-03-03 meeting; last updated 2026-03-04 (added action statuses and links).
